question: ​Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"happen."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Happen"** is the correct verb form to use in the present tense.
 
• The subject in this case is **"things**" which is plural so we need a plural verb with it.
 
• The sentence is discussing a current or ongoing event, which is why the present tense is needed.
 
• **"Happen"** is the plural form of the verb **"happen"** in the present tense.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.
 
• Correct passage:

“Why?" said Harry in surprise, “There is a plot__, Harry Potter. A plot to make most terrible things __happen__ at Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry ______ (3) ______," whispered Dobby, suddenly trembling all over. “Dobby has ______ (4) ______ months, sir. Harry Potter ______ (5) ______ in peril. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2,** "happens,"** is a conjugated form of "happen" but is not the correct form for the sentence.
 
• Option 3, **"happening,"** is a present participle form that would be used in a different context.
 
• Option 4, **"happened,"** is a past tense form that would not be appropriate for a present tense sentence.
